All four section 4.4 conditions did hold at the decision point (Sonnet three batteries 31.92 USD <= 36; P10O1 20.57 <= 25; clock allowed it; 95 USD total intact), so this is a deliberate cut and not a gate failure. Plan E's priority order puts trustworthy measurement first and explicitly cuts optional model calls first; the spec's own cut order lists P10O2 first. Saved approximately 20 USD; total live spend approximately 52.48 USD of the 95 USD cap.
conclusion: The instrument's noise is larger than every difference this project has published. Sonnet cited_right_page_equiv over four identical runs: 13, 13, 11, 11 (v3, range 2) and 13, 14, 10, 9 (v2, range 5). Only 10 of 17 questions held the same verdict across all four. Pre-registered rule applies: no configuration may be preferred on a difference smaller than the range, which rules out every model-to-model and stack-to-stack claim in the report so far.
